subject: Paper jam keeps coming back after all checks
description: Receipt printer jams again every few receipts.

ticket_history.note: Guided paper path cleaning and roll reseat per printer-paper-jam runbook. Jam recurred after 3 receipts.
Reinstalled printer driver and power cycled printer and POS. Jam recurred.
Replaced paper roll with new 80mm stock. Still jamming. 35 minutes of troubleshooting logged.
